about: An open-source office suite SDK for spreadsheets, documents and slides that apps can embed.

prs.title: ISO week numbers are right at the turn of the year
prs.broken: ISOWEEKNUM gave wrong week numbers around new year, such as week 53 or 54 where it should be week 1, and a whole year was off by one in some years.
prs.changed: The ISO week start is computed the standard way, and the time part of a date no longer shifts the result.
prs.matters: Spreadsheets that plan or report by week get the same numbers as Excel.
